summary: Frontend-only regression + feature verification for StoreX Admin Add Product (Cloudinary upload alongside Unsplash), Zod validation, verify-email failure UX, and admin regression. All requested flows PASS. No white screens, no runtime errors, no broken routes across admin area.
verified_flows: Add Product page shows BOTH the Unsplash search bar (input[placeholder*='Search images'] + Search button) AND the new Cloudinary upload control (data-testid=upload-image-label / upload-image-input) separated by an 'OR' divider.

Unsplash search regression: typing 'tshirt' + clicking Search renders a grid of 6 demo images; clicking one adds it to 'Selected Images (1/5)'; clicking the red X removes it and the section disappears.

Cloudinary upload with placeholder keys handles failure GRACEFULLY — file input accepts a real PNG, page does NOT crash / no white screen, upload-image-label still present after failure, uploading toast text observed. (Backend already curl-verified to return 502 graceful error; client toast.error path in handleFileUpload catch block wired correctly.)

Product-create validation: submitting with no images (after satisfying HTML5 required for name/slug/price/category/brand) triggers toast 'Please select at least one image' — no crash. Empty category/brand blocked by HTML5 required (browser-native).
/verify-email?token=badtoken renders data-testid=verify-error with text 'Verification Failed — Invalid or expired verification link.' and a 'Go to Sign In' link. No crash.
/admin/analytics loads: stat cards (Revenue ₹35,560 etc.), range dropdown (Last 7/30/90 days, Last year), Export Orders (CSV) button all render.
/admin/inventory lists products (1 row visible in table).
/admin (Overview) dashboard renders: Total Revenue ₹35741.45, Total Orders 56, Customers 7, Recent Activity.
/products lists 2 product cards; clicking → /products/:slug renders detail page (h1 'Puma Tshirt', ₹599, Add to Bag button, Quantity picker, Free Shipping/Easy Returns/Secure badges).
critical_code_review_comments: client/src/pages/admin/AddProduct.jsx: Unsplash 'fallback demo images' path calls api.unsplash.com with the literal string 'YOUR_ACCESS_KEY' (line ~75) before returning demo results — the failing network request is wasted and pollutes the network tab. Consider skipping the fetch entirely when UNSPLASH_ACCESS_KEY is empty.

toast.info(...) is used at line 86 but react-hot-toast has no .info() method (only success/error/loading/custom) — this will throw a runtime error IF the fetch above ever returns !ok. Currently masked because the failing fetch throws before reaching it, but it is a latent bug; use toast(...) or toast.success(...).

handleFileUpload sends FormData with an explicit 'Content-Type: multipart/form-data' header — axios normally sets this automatically WITH the boundary; forcing it manually usually drops the boundary and breaks multipart on some axios versions. Backend accepted the placeholder-Cloudinary flow here, but this should be removed to be safe.
removeImage sends DELETE /admin/upload with .catch(()=>{}) which silently swallows errors — fine for UX but should at least console.warn for observability.
seed_data_creation: None. No product was submitted (Neon DB untouched). Only harmless Unsplash-demo image selection/deselection + a 1x1 PNG upload attempt that failed gracefully as expected.
